The `expectSymbols` rows are an OWNER pin, and they exist because of a retraction rather than a fix: this review had recorded that 37.8% of `overrides` edges resolved ambiguously, which turned out to be an artefact of measuring the analyzer instead of the store — `nameToSymbol` carries an owner-qualified key, so these three same-named methods resolve exactly. The dependency is real and load-bearing even though the defect was not, and before this commit it was pinned only incidentally: the mutant that strips `ownerName` was caught by the `contains` derivation, a different consumer of the same field. A pin held up by an unrelated fixture is one edit away from disappearing, so the three `handle` methods here — three classes, one leaf name, the precise shape the false finding was about — now carry their owner as a direct assertion.
